description: Whether ONZIP covers a neighbourhood (the first three characters of a Canadian postal code, e.g. L8P) and how many approved providers serve it for each home service (1–2 are shown as "few" so no single provider is singled out). accepting_requests says whether a person can send a request through ONZIP there yet. Give a service id to also get that service's request form questions (keys, choices, ranges) — the answers a quote draft takes (drafts are made on ONZIP's own MCP server, not this one). No provider names, contacts or prices.

postal_fsa.description: Forward sortation area — the first 3 characters of the postal code only, e.g. L8P. Never send a full postal code.

service.description: Service id from onzip_list_services, e.g. repair.

name: onzip_check_coverage
title: Check ONZIP coverage for a neighbourhood
